subject: Mythology
title: Moksha: Liberation and Freedom
description: A short lesson to help you apply Moksha: Liberation and Freedom.

hook.text: Moksha is the ultimate goal of Hindu life — escaping the cycle of rebirth and merging with the infinite divine.

buildup.text: It can be achieved through devotion, knowledge, selfless action, or meditation — each path suits different people.

discovery.text: When moksha is reached, the individual soul realizes it was never separate from the universal soul at all.

twist.text: Moksha is not a place you go. It is the realization that you were always already there, blinded by illusion.

climax.text: This concept influenced Buddhism, Jainism, Sikhism, and modern spiritual movements across the entire world.

punchline.text: Freedom is not a destination. It is waking up from a dream you forgot.

quiz.question: What is moksha in Hindu belief?
options: Rebirth as a god in the highest heaven
Liberation from the cycle of rebirth and union with the divine
Achieving perfect health and immortality on earth
